implementation.installationBoundary: Requires PostgreSQL 16 and an owned cinashop_kefu_runner_<32hex> test database; no production entrypoint
implementation.admission: AFTER INSERT/UPDATE validates final row values, source owner and explicit/implicit template identity; holds template SHARE NOWAIT to transaction end
implementation.retirement: AFTER UPDATE/DELETE rejects retained references across all six tables under fresh READ COMMITTED catalog/data reads
implementation.ownerChanges: Product owner changes revalidate independent activity bindings; referenced parent identity/owner changes rejected
implementation.security: SECURITY INVOKER, schema-qualified relations, row_security=off to fail rather than silently filter dependencies
implementation.retiredReferences: Conservative candidate keeps stored references protected until explicitly unbound/deleted; not an approved historical-retention policy
